# Migration Performance Benchmarker Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Benchmark migrated system performance against legacy baselines and SLA targets.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [migration-performance-benchmarker-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
migration-performance-benchmarker-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@migration-performance-benchmarker` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze technical systems and identify areas for improvement
- Execute automated workflows with validation checkpoints
- Apply technology-specific best practices and industry standards
- Generate structured technical outputs with quality metrics

## Industry Standards Applied

- **AWS 7R Migration**: Migration strategies: rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, retire, retain, relocate
- **TOGAF ADM**: Architecture development method for transformation initiatives
- **Strangler Fig Pattern**: Incremental migration pattern for legacy system replacement
